channel.title: Jane Friedman Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Jane Friedman Media (janefriedman.com)

item.title: New agent at Calligraph
item.description: Jane McGehee has joined as literary agent and foreign rights manager; previously she was a scout.

item.title: New contest for novelists around the globe
item.description: ProWritingAid has launched a novel-writing contest called Novel Beginnings, with prizes ranging from $5,000 to $50,000.

item.title: Washington Post shutters book section after one-third of staff laid off this morning
item.description: The newspaper is closing the sports desk and books section; the international desk, among other areas, will also shrink.

item.title: New agent at The Rights Factory
item.description: Eman Bare will represent both fiction and nonfiction. She has worked as a journalist, lawyer, and brand strategist.

item.title: Finding the Right Tone for Your Memoir
item.description: Your story’s tone and content don’t have to match—and when they don’t, they can combine to create something greater than their sum.
